projectName: Bar 4 Bar Studio — 90-Day Web-Only Revenue Plan

tasks.description: Establish the one-line positioning used everywhere: Bar 4 Bar is the rhyme book + co-writer for rappers and songwriters who think in bars—not paragraphs.
checklist: Write one-line positioning for all channels
Document what Bar 4 Bar is NOT (not ChatGPT in a box, not Suno/Udio, not a DAW)
Align all landing page and ad copy to this statement

tasks.description: Identify the three primary customer segments to target in all marketing and product messaging.
dependencies: Lock Core Positioning Statement
checklist: Independent rappers / lyricists writing seriously (not casual one-shot tourists)
Songwriters with messy notes, voice memos, and half-finished verses
Producers who write toplines and need structure + rhyme discipline

tasks.taskName: Select Primary Problem to Lead With in Ads
tasks.description: Choose the #1 problem hook for cold traffic: I'm stuck on the next bar — rhyme, syllables, flow continuity. Secondary rotation: chaos to structure via Paste Your Lyrics.
dependencies: Define Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
checklist: Primary hook: stuck on the next bar (Generate Next Line + Rhyme Pulse visual in 10 seconds)
Secondary hook: paste mess to structured verse/hook blocks (+ Paste Your Lyrics with [Verse]/[Hook])
Tertiary hooks queued: generic AI sounds like everyone else (DNA/guardrails/style training)
Quaternary hooks queued: losing ideas between sessions (vault, share links on Pro)

tasks.taskName: Define Price Anchor and Tier Story
tasks.description: Map the free-to-paid upgrade narrative using current tiers: Visitor free demo, Pro Monthly $7.77/mo, Pro Yearly ~$4.44/mo effective with more Ink and 50% off ink packs.
dependencies: Lock Core Positioning Statement
checklist: Visitor: 250 signup Ink + 150/mo residency, 1 album, 2 tracks, all Creative Effects on Ink
Pro Monthly: $7.77/mo, 1,777 Ink/mo, unlimited projects, full co-writer unlocks
Pro Yearly: $4.44/mo effective ($53.28/yr), 3,444 Ink/mo, ~43% sub savings vs monthly, 50% off Permanent Ink packs
Push monthly Pro in ads; mention yearly on pricing page and to power users only

tasks.taskName: Establish Build vs Market Rules for 90 Days
tasks.description: Commit to 80% marketing / 20% build-only-if-blocking for the full 90-day window. Do not build native apps, social feeds, beat marketplace, or new AI modalities until MRR justifies it.
checklist: Market now: screen demos, free demo to Pro story, TikTok/Reels/Shorts, pricing/yearly story, SEO keywords
Build only if blocking: prod stability, signup to first AI onboarding, PWA prompt, share/DNA Drop loop, landing hero
Do NOT build in 90 days: native iOS/Android store apps, social network/feeds, beat marketplace, video/music gen modes, complex tier changes

phases.phaseName: Foundation — Days 1–30 (Fix Funnel and Prove Conversion)

tasks.taskName: Fix Production Firebase and Billing Stability
tasks.description: Critical prerequisite before any paid traffic. Ensure Cloud Run does not reference missing firebase-service-account.json; AI actions and ink deduction must work end-to-end on mobile web.
dependencies: Establish Build vs Market Rules for 90 Days
checklist: Remove GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS from deployed env; use ADC on Cloud Run
Move service account path to .env.local only (not deployed)
Verify generateNextLine and draft generation return 200 in production
Verify Stripe checkout to fulfillment to Pro unlock works on mobile web
Confirm signup to first AI action completes without Studio billing temporarily unavailable

tasks.taskName: Optimize Landing Page and First CTA
tasks.description: Ensure the homepage/landing clearly communicates bar-by-bar co-writer value with a single Start free CTA above the fold.
dependencies: Lock Core Positioning Statement
Fix Production Firebase and Billing Stability
checklist: Hero copy reflects rhyme book + co-writer for bars positioning
Single primary CTA: Start free — 250 Ink
Mobile layout tested — no horizontal scroll or broken CTAs
Link to /pricing visible but secondary to signup CTA

tasks.description: Prompt mobile users to Add to Home Screen after first session for full-screen studio experience (web app works on phone without App Store).
dependencies: Fix Production Firebase and Billing Stability
checklist: Surface PWA install prompt after first successful AI action or second session
End-card copy: Add to Home Screen for full-screen studio
Test on iOS Safari and Android Chrome

tasks.taskName: Deploy and Verify Admin Growth Metrics Dashboard
tasks.description: Confirm Admin Panel Growth Metrics tab loads and tracks all KPIs: signups, activation, pricing funnel, MRR, retention, free tier pressure, ad CPS.
dependencies: Fix Production Firebase and Billing Stability
checklist: Deploy Firestore rules for analytics_events and studioMetrics/marketing
Deploy hosting with admin panel fix (no vault redirect)
Verify event tracking: signup, session_start, track_editor_open, pricing_view, checkout_started/completed, ai_action, free_limit_hit
Confirm ad spend manual entry calculates cost per signup and cost per activated user

tasks.description: Market lightly with 3–5 short screen recordings per week on TikTok + Instagram Reels. No paid spend yet. Goal: first organic Pro checkout.
dependencies: Select Primary Problem to Lead With in Ads
Optimize Landing Page and First CTA
checklist: Post 3–5 vertical screen demos per week (15–25 sec, 9:16)
1 Reddit post per week (r/WeAreTheMusicMakers, r/Songwriting, r/rap)
1–2 Twitter/X threads showing bar-by-bar workflow per week
Use dark UI + real finger taps — not mockups
CTA every post: Free demo — link in bio or 250 Ink free

tasks.taskName: Create Ad Creative Template (Organic Use First)
tasks.description: Standardize the 15–25 second vertical ad structure for all organic and future paid content.
dependencies: Select Primary Problem to Lead With in Ads
checklist: Sec 0–2: Hook pain — Stuck on the next bar?
Sec 2–8: Screen record — paste messy lyrics
Sec 8–14: Smart Structure or Generate Next Line — split into hooks and bars
Sec 14–20: Co-writer badges / Rhyme Pulse flash — Not generic paragraphs
Sec 20–25: CTA — Free demo — link in bio / 250 Ink free
Optional face: hands + screen outperforms talking head for tool demos

tasks.description: Review metrics weekly during Days 1–30. Most values may be zero early — that is expected. Focus on funnel health signals.
dependencies: Deploy and Verify Admin Growth Metrics Dashboard
Launch Organic Content Week 1–4
checklist: Signups (total and weekly)
Percent who open track editor within 24h
Percent who use Generate Next Line or Paste Your Lyrics once
Pricing page visits per signup
First Pro checkout (target: 1–3/week is a win early)
Ink depleted to upgrade click rate
Revenue target: $50–200/mo from first Pro + occasional ink packs

phases.phaseName: Growth Engine — Days 31–60 (Paid Tests and Content Engine)

tasks.taskName: Build Signup to First AI Onboarding Checklist
tasks.description: Only build item for Phase 2 if not done: 3-step in-app checklist — paste lyrics, generate one bar, save track.
dependencies: Fix Production Firebase and Billing Stability
Track Phase 1 Weekly KPIs
checklist: Step 1: Prompt user to paste lyrics (+ Paste Your Lyrics)
Step 2: Prompt user to generate one bar (Generate Next Line)
Step 3: Prompt user to save / return to track
Measure time-to-first-AI and activation rate impact

tasks.description: Ensure /pricing converts on mobile — tier comparison, yearly toggle, and upgrade CTAs must be thumb-friendly.
dependencies: Define Price Anchor and Tier Story
checklist: Yearly toggle shows ~43% subscription savings vs monthly (50% is ink packs only)
Pro Monthly $7.77 and Pro Yearly $4.44/mo effective clearly displayed
Upgrade CTA routes to /usage?tab=cloud
Track pricing_view and upgrade_click events in admin metrics

tasks.taskName: Launch Paid Ad Tests $10–20 Per Day
tasks.description: Run TikTok Spark Ads or Meta Reels ads testing 3 hooks x 2 creatives. Goal: find one channel + one hook that converts at acceptable CAC.
dependencies: Fix Production Firebase and Billing Stability
Launch Organic Content Week 1–4
Create Ad Creative Template (Organic Use First)
checklist: Budget: $10–20/day across TikTok and/or Meta Reels
Test 3 hooks x 2 creatives (6 variants minimum)
Hook A: POV you have had the same 4 bars for 3 weeks
Hook B: Stop asking ChatGPT for a whole song
Hook C: Your notes app is not a rhyme book
Outcome hook: Watch AI land the next bar not rewrite your whole song
Objection killer: Web studio works on phone no download + show PWA add-to-home
Flow: Ad on phone to link in bio to mobile web signup to first AI action to PWA prompt
Do NOT scale spend until prod billing is confirmed working

tasks.description: Retarget site visitors who viewed pricing or used AI but did not checkout.
dependencies: Launch Paid Ad Tests $10–20 Per Day
checklist: Install Meta pixel on site
Create retargeting audience: visited /pricing or /usage in last 7 days, no purchase
Retarget ad message: Unlock unlimited albums + full co-writer — $7.77/mo
Track pricing to checkout start to paid in admin metrics

tasks.description: Offer lead magnet on pricing page: Get 50 bar-writing tips PDF — not more Ink. Build list for nurture.
dependencies: Improve Pricing Page Mobile Layout
checklist: Add email capture form to /pricing
Create simple PDF lead magnet (50 bar-writing tips)
Connect to email tool (Mailchimp, ConvertKit, etc.)
Only prioritize after 100+ pricing page views

tasks.taskName: Create Before/After Screenshot Assets for Social
tasks.description: Build shareable before/after visuals: messy notes to structured verse/hook blocks for social proof in ads and organic posts.
dependencies: Create Ad Creative Template (Organic Use First)
checklist: Capture screenshot: raw pasted lyrics chaos
Capture screenshot: same lyrics after Smart Structure split
Capture screenshot: Generate Next Line landing on rhyme
Use in Reels, TikTok, and Reddit posts

tasks.description: Review paid and organic metrics weekly. Target 2–5% free to Pro conversion of activated users within 30 days.
dependencies: Launch Paid Ad Tests $10–20 Per Day
Deploy and Verify Admin Growth Metrics Dashboard
checklist: Cost per signup (CPS)
Cost per activated user (used AI once)
Cost per Pro trial/purchase
7-day retention (returned to same track)
Free to Pro conversion rate (target: 2–5% of activated users in 30 days)
Pricing to checkout start to paid funnel rates
Revenue target: $300–800/mo (10–25 Pro subs mix + ink packs)

tasks.description: At end of Phase 2, declare one winning ad hook and one winning channel based on lowest cost per activated user and highest checkout completion.
dependencies: Track Phase 2 Weekly KPIs
checklist: Compare CPS and cost per activated user across TikTok vs Meta
Compare hook performance (stuck on next bar vs chaos to structure vs objection killer)
Kill underperforming ad sets
Document winner in admin marketing notes field

phases.phaseName: Scale and Partnerships — Days 61–90 (Double Down and Grow MRR)

tasks.description: Double budget ONLY on the single best-performing ad set from Phase 2. Do not spread spend across untested variants.
dependencies: Identify Winning Hook and Channel
checklist: Increase daily spend 2x on winner only
Pause all other ad sets
Monitor checkout completion rate daily for first week
If CPS rises more than 50%, reduce budget and refresh creative

tasks.description: Repurpose top-performing TikTok/Reels clips to YouTube Shorts for longer shelf life and secondary discovery.
dependencies: Identify Winning Hook and Channel
checklist: Upload top 5 performing organic/paid clips to YouTube Shorts
Use same hooks and CTAs with link in description
Post 2–3 Shorts per week ongoing

tasks.description: Seed 5–10 micro-influencers (beatmakers, writing coaches) with free Pro for honest demo videos.
dependencies: Identify Winning Hook and Channel
checklist: Identify 10 micro-influencers (5K–50K followers) in rap/s songwriting niche
Offer free Pro Monthly or Yearly in exchange for honest demo video
Provide creative template and talking points (stuck on next bar hook)
Track signups with UTM or unique landing mention
Target: 5–10 seedings, 2–3 posted videos minimum

tasks.taskName: Activate DNA Drop Share Link Growth Loop
tasks.description: Market Pro share links (DNA Drop live links) as collab and feedback loop. Optional: build public /demo read-only track for ads.
dependencies: Scale Winning Ad Set 2x Budget
checklist: Add share link CTA in Pro user onboarding tip
Create social post showing DNA Drop share flow
Optional build: public /demo read-only track for ad landing (no login required preview)
Track share link creation count in admin metrics

tasks.taskName: Launch SEO Content 2 Posts Per Month
tasks.description: Start slow SEO: 2 blog posts per month targeting long-tail songwriting keywords. Slow channel — do not over-invest early.
dependencies: Lock Core Positioning Statement
checklist: Post 1: How to structure a rap verse with [Verse] and [Hook] labels
Post 2: Bar-by-bar songwriting vs whole-song AI generators
Target keywords: AI lyric writer, rhyme book app, rap lyrics generator, lyric workstation, DNA remix lyrics
Internal link to /pricing and free signup

tasks.description: Based on Phase 2 data, decide whether to add Reddit/Discord honest tool posts or Google Search ads. Skip Twitter ads and mass influencer buys.
dependencies: Track Phase 2 Weekly KPIs
checklist: Reddit/Discord: 1 honest tool post if organic traction is strong (high trust, low volume)
Skip Google Search ads for now (expensive for AI lyrics keywords)
Skip Twitter ads
Skip influencer mass buys — micro only
Email nurture: only after 500+ signups

tasks.taskName: Track Phase 3 Weekly KPIs and 90-Day Success Review
tasks.description: Final 30-day push toward 90-day success definition. Review all metrics and decide Month 4 strategy.
dependencies: Scale Winning Ad Set 2x Budget
Micro-Influencer Seeding Campaign
checklist: MRR + ink pack revenue (track in admin metrics)
Monthly churn rate (monthly Pro cancels)
LTV estimate: monthly Pro ~$7.77 x avg 4 mo â‰ˆ $31; yearly ~$53 upfront
Organic vs paid signup split
7-day return rate
Revenue target: $800–2,000/mo if one hook + offer clicks
90-day success: 30–80 paying Pro users + $400–1,500 MRR + one repeatable ad hook under ~$15–25 CPS
Enter total ad spend in admin Paid Acquisition section for final CPS report

tasks.description: Full playbook for advertising a web app on phone-first platforms. Web converts via mobile browser + PWA — no App Store required.
dependencies: Select Primary Problem to Lead With in Ads
checklist: Yes — advertise on TikTok/Instagram even though product is web-only
Conversion flow: Ad to link in bio to mobile web signup to first AI action to Add to Home Screen (PWA)
Compete on 30-second outcome (next bar appears / chaos becomes structure), not App Store presence
Format: 9:16 vertical, 15–25 seconds, no logo-first intro
Shoot style: dark UI, gold/amber accents, finger taps on real UI
Post 3–5x/week organic; paid tests in Phase 2

tasks.description: Complete hook library for cold, warm, and objection-killer creatives. Rotate weekly during paid tests.
dependencies: TikTok and Instagram Reels Playbook
checklist: Problem: POV you have had the same 4 bars for 3 weeks
Problem: Stop asking ChatGPT for a whole song
Problem: Your notes app is not a rhyme book
Problem: I paste my mess and it becomes verse / hook / verse
Outcome: Watch AI land the next bar not rewrite your whole song
Outcome: Rhyme pulse + next line in one workstation
Outcome: From voice memo chaos to structured lyrics in 60 seconds
Objection: Web studio works on phone no download + PWA demo
Objection: Free tier is a real demo not a 3-day trial scam
CTA: Try free — 250 Ink / Write bar 5 today / Link in bio Bar 4 Bar Studio

tasks.description: Match ad message and upgrade moment to audience temperature using current tier structure.
dependencies: Define Price Anchor and Tier Story
checklist: Cold traffic: Free demo — paste + next bar. Upgrade when 2-track limit or Ink runs low
Warm retarget: Unlock unlimited albums + full co-writer — $7.77/mo for pricing visitors with 3+ AI uses
Heavy users: Yearly pitch — more Ink/mo + 50% off refills when Ink depleted twice in one month
Free tier limits to reference in ads: 1 album, 2 tracks, 250 signup + 150/mo Ink

tasks.description: Ranked channel list for 90-day web-only SaaS growth. Focus top 3; deprioritize rest.
checklist: 1. TikTok + Instagram Reels — best discovery; web fine via mobile browser/PWA
2. YouTube Shorts — same clips, longer shelf life
3. Reddit / Discord — honest tool posts (high trust, low volume)
4. SEO / blog — slow; 2 posts/month starting Phase 3
5. Paid Meta Reels — after organic hooks prove out (Phase 2)
6. Email — only after 500+ signups
Skip: Twitter ads, Google Search ads, influencer mass buys

tasks.description: Weekly admin review of all KPIs in Growth Metrics tab. Enter ad spend manually to calculate CPS and cost per activated user.
dependencies: Deploy and Verify Admin Growth Metrics Dashboard
checklist: Signups — top of funnel
Activation rate — 1+ AI action (target 40–60% early)
Time to first Generate Next Line — core value moment
Free limit hits — 2 tracks / low Ink upgrade trigger
Pricing to checkout start to paid — monetization funnel
MRR + ink pack revenue
7-day return rate — stickiness
Ad CPS / cost per activated user — scale decision (target under $15–25 CPS)
Free tier pressure: users at album/track limits, low ink, limit-hit events
